result.question: Quais hospitais têm mais de 1000 internações registradas?
result.gold_sql: SELECT h."CNES", COUNT(i."N_AIH") AS total_internacoes FROM hospital h JOIN internacoes i ON h."CNES" = i."CNES" GROUP BY h."CNES" HAVING COUNT(i."N_AIH") > 1000 ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC;
result.generated_sql: SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;
